description: This file defines a class ResourcesLibraryTableConfigResolver that configures and manages resource table settings, actions, and interactions within an Angular application, specifically for the resources library page in the admin section.

classes.name: ResourcesLibraryTableConfigResolver
classes.description: An Angular service class that provides configuration and management for the resources library table, including actions like download, delete, and resource editing, with support for dialogs and navigation.

methods.name: saveResource
methods.description: Saves or uploads a resource, handling both new uploads and updates to existing resources, including batch uploads.

methods.name: resolve
methods.description: Configures and returns the table configuration for the resources library page, setting titles, permissions, and data fetch functions.

methods.name: openResource
methods.description: Navigates to the resource detail page for a given resource.

methods.name: downloadResource
methods.description: Triggers download of a specified resource.

methods.name: onResourceAction
methods.description: Handles user actions on resource items such as open, download, or delete.

methods.name: detailsReadonly
methods.description: Determines if resource details should be read-only based on resource type and user authority.

methods.name: isResourceEditable
methods.description: Checks if a resource is editable based on user authority and resource tenant ID.

methods.name: deleteResource
methods.description: Deletes a single resource, with confirmation and error handling, including references check.

methods.name: deleteResources
methods.description: Deletes multiple resources with confirmation, handling references and errors.
